newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade slow at $63-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade slow at $63-USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 3,100 slaughter steers and 1,900 heifers; 79,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,800 formulated and 1,000 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 62.50. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00.
Wk to date - 79,300 Week Ago - 85,000 Year Ago - 57,900
